metadata.author: quant-os
metadata.rationale: Breakeven Proxy: SL=1.5 ATR defence, TP=1.0 ATR breakeven trigger. The model predicts whether price reaches the breakeven threshold before the stop — a Momentum Ignition predictor. Once breakeven triggers, the execution engine (trail + breakeven) takes over, creating a risk-free asymmetric payoff. Timeout rate ~7.5% (vs 60%+ for 3.5 ATR TP), dramatically increasing label efficiency.
metadata.design_notes: M5 profitability surface scan (66,933 bars, 44,548 entries) confirmed: SL=1.5/TP=1.0 is the optimal ignition-detection contract with 56.1% TP hit rate blind, 7.5% timeout. All TP >= 3.0 ATR configs eliminated by >60% timeout. The ML model's job is to filter out the 36.5% SL hits through 49-dim microstructural feature analysis.
